name: KCD:MP Feudal Wars
author: lol1luv@users.noreply.github.com
description: KCD:MP dedicated server running the Feudal Wars game mode (houses, wars, treasury, economy, web UI, admin console). Full deployment: downloads the server build, .NET 10 runtime and provisions the game mode database.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd /mnt/server

say()  { echo "[fw-install] $*"; }
warn() { echo "[fw-install] WARNING: $*"; }
fail() { echo "[fw-install] ERROR: $*"; }

say "=============================================================="
say "Feudal Wars install"
say "=============================================================="

# /tmp inside the container is a tiny tmpfs: keep temp files on disk
mkdir -p /mnt/server/tmp
export TMPDIR=/mnt/server/tmp
export TMP=/mnt/server/tmp
export TEMP=/mnt/server/tmp

# .NET 10 runtime (the app host is 10.0.x)
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/dotnet/dotnet ]; then
  say "step 1/5: installing the .NET 10 runtime ..."
  curl -sSLf https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh -o /mnt/server/tmp/dotnet-install.sh
  chmod +x /mnt/server/tmp/dotnet-install.sh
  /mnt/server/tmp/dotnet-install.sh --channel 10.0 --runtime dotnet --install-dir /mnt/server/dotnet
  say "step 1/5: .NET 10 runtime installed"
else
  say "step 1/5: .NET 10 runtime already present"
fi

# One download of the repo head: binaries, mode and the starter all come from it.
say "step 2/5: downloading the repo head ..."
curl -sSLf https://codeload.github.com/lol1luv/kcd-mp-feudalwars/tar.gz/refs/heads/main -o /mnt/server/tmp/src.tar.gz
mkdir -p /mnt/server/tmp/src
tar xzf /mnt/server/tmp/src.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/tmp/src
SRC_DIR=$(find /mnt/server/tmp/src -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | head -1)
say "step 2/5: downloaded $(wc -c < /mnt/server/tmp/src.tar.gz | tr -d ' ') bytes, unpacked to $(basename "$SRC_DIR")"

say "step 3/5: installing the server binaries ..."
cp -f "$SRC_DIR"/KcdMp.Server /mnt/server/KcdMp.Server
cp -f "$SRC_DIR"/*.dll /mnt/server/ 2>/dev/null || true
cp -f "$SRC_DIR"/*.so /mnt/server/ 2>/dev/null || true
cp -f "$SRC_DIR"/KcdMp.Server.deps.json /mnt/server/KcdMp.Server.deps.json
cp -f "$SRC_DIR"/KcdMp.Server.runtimeconfig.json /mnt/server/KcdMp.Server.runtimeconfig.json
cp -f "$SRC_DIR"/server.toml.example /mnt/server/server.toml.example
say "step 3/5: binaries installed ($(ls -1 /mnt/server/*.dll 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ') dll, $(ls -1 /mnt/server/*.so 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ') so)"

say "step 4/5: installing the Feudal Wars game mode ..."
mkdir -p /mnt/server/gamemodes
if [ ! -f "$SRC_DIR/gamemodes/feudalwars.lua" ]; then
  fail "the repo has no gamemodes/feudalwars.lua"
  exit 1
fi
cp -f "$SRC_DIR/gamemodes/feudalwars.lua" /mnt/server/gamemodes/feudalwars.lua
rm -rf /mnt/server/gamemodes/feudalwars
mkdir -p /mnt/server/gamemodes/feudalwars
cp -rf "$SRC_DIR"/gamemodes/feudalwars/. /mnt/server/gamemodes/feudalwars/
MODULES=$(cd /mnt/server/gamemodes/feudalwars && ls -1 *.lua 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' ')
UI_N=$(find /mnt/server/gamemodes/feudalwars/ui -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
say "step 4/5: entry $(wc -l < /mnt/server/gamemodes/feudalwars.lua | tr -d ' ') lines"
say "step 4/5: modules: ${MODULES:-<none>}"
say "step 4/5: ui: $UI_N files"

# starter: syncs the mode from the repo on every boot, no API rate limits
cp -f "$SRC_DIR/pterodactyl-start.sh" /mnt/server/start.sh
chmod +x /mnt/server/start.sh
rm -rf /mnt/server/tmp/src

say "step 5/5: writing server.toml and the runtime profile ..."
# server.toml: write it only when absent, so a reinstall keeps the level and other
# settings the operator set. Wings rewrites [gamemode.database] from DB_* at start.
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/server.toml ]; then
cat > /mnt/server/server.toml <<EOF
[server]
name = "${SERVER_NAME:-KCD:MP Feudal Wars}"
port = ${SERVER_PORT}
max_players = ${MAX_PLAYERS:-32}
password = "${SERVER_PASSWORD:-}"
level = "${LEVEL:-kutnohorsko}"

[gamemode]
script = "gamemodes/feudalwars.lua"
watch = false

[gamemode.database]
driver = ""

[world]
map = "data/maps/{level}"

[commands]
builtin = true
EOF
  say "step 5/5: server.toml written (level ${LEVEL:-kutnohorsko})"
else
  say "step 5/5: server.toml kept as it is"
fi

# the entrypoint runs STARTUP through eval; make the local .NET 10 runtime visible
cat > /mnt/server/.bash_profile <<EOF
export DOTNET_ROOT=/home/container/dotnet
export DOTNET_ROOT_X64=/home/container/dotnet
export PATH=\$PATH:/home/container/dotnet
EOF
chmod +x KcdMp.Server
mkdir -p /mnt/server/data
rm -rf /mnt/server/tmp

say "=============================================================="
say "Installation finished. Start the server to sync and launch."
say "=============================================================="

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the server browser.

variables.name: Level
variables.description: Map level: klaster, trosecko or kutnohorsko. Kuttenberg = kutnohorsko.

variables.name: Database Driver
variables.description: Database driver: mysql (MariaDB) or postgres. Empty = no database (memory only).
